# Wang et al. 2023 floral-symmetry source snapshot

The source is supplementary Data S2 from Wang et al. (2023), *Global
distribution and evolutionary transitions of floral symmetry in
angiosperms*, Science Advances, DOI `10.1126/sciadv.adg2555`; Dryad DOI
`10.5061/dryad.ghx3ffbrh` (CC0).

The immutable source object is `adg2555_Data_S2.rdata` (279,877 rows;
SHA-256
`c381206d3f99825fc766e66425a123cea055682432e448358727ecf831d5c45b`).
It was retrieved without a search API from the Europe PMC supplementary-file
endpoint:

```text
https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC10599613/supplementaryFiles
```

`wang_2023_species_symmetry_snapshot.csv.gz` is a lossless, deterministic
CSV export of the R object `dataset`; it retains source row, order, family,
genus, species, raw symmetry, and both note fields. The snapshot is an input,
not accepted evidence. Formal promotion is performed by the separate
family-validation checkpoint and excludes unresolved names, family conflicts,
the paper's controversial family definitions, and families without adequate
independent direct validation.
